```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(tidyverse)

source("00-paths.R")
```

```{r}
x <- read.csv("../data/derived/slids.csv")

head(x)
```

```{r}
files <- list.files(file.path("T:", "Labs", "Spakowicz", 
                     "projects", "exotic", "download_urls",
                     "fastq", "2021-02-22"),
                    full.names = TRUE)

files
```

```{r}
z <- lapply(files, function(x) readLines(x) %>% data.frame) %>%
  bind_rows() %>%
  dplyr::rename("url" = ".")

dim(z)
```

Retrieve just the unique SLid for comparison. 

```{r}
slids <- 
  z %>%
  mutate(SLid = gsub("http.*/(SL.*)_[1,2]\\.fastq\\.gz", "\\1", url)) %>%
  select(SLid) %>%
  unique
```


```{r}
sum(x$RNA.SLID %in% slids$SLid)
```

Ok good! We have access to all of them.
